subtitle: Exploration of AI and data-driven approaches with potential industrial application

description.summary: Computer vision prototype for classifying screws as OK or defective in an industrial inspection scenario.
description.context: Exploration of deep learning for visual quality control in manufacturing-like environments.
description.challenge: Training a reliable classifier with limited data, class imbalance, and subtle visual defects.
description.solution: Built a transfer learning pipeline with MobileNetV2, data augmentation, class balancing, and evaluation metrics focused on inspection performance.
